## [3.56.0] - 2026-07-23

### Features

- prevent discounts on repair-related lines across cart functionalities
- enhance PayTag POS functionality and clean up code - Add support for guest checkout in KioskPhoneLookupStatus - Improve handling of PayTag cart actions and item removal - Update .gitignore to exclude build artifacts - Refactor KioskCustomerLookupService to streamline customer lookup - Adjust UI components to reflect PayTag-specific behaviors

### Bug Fixes

- enhance refund handling and UI updates across multiple components
- prevent discounts on orders with repair items
